title: Private Romantic Heritage Walk in Historic Ottawa
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Enjoy a private romantic walking tour through the historic heart of Ottawa. Share memorable moments while exploring Canada's capital, where historic landmarks and cultural heritage reflect centuries of national history that long predate the modern United States. Wander through elegant streets lined with magnificent architecture, inspiring monuments, and picturesque public spaces.

Which love stories are connected to Ottawa's historic landmarks? How did this distinguished capital grow into the cultural heart of Canada? Your professional guide will reveal captivating stories of romance, heritage, and architectural excellence while you discover the city's timeless charm together. This premium experience blends history, culture, and romance into an inspiring journey through one of Canada's most distinguished historic capitals.

Please note: The program and attractions may vary based on booking date/time and crowd conditions, ensuring each visit is a unique experience.
